Run Tumor2Line matching in a frozen external reference PCA space

Source: R/08_external_reference.R
run_tumor2line_with_reference.Rd

Projects query samples and candidate cell lines into a frozen external reference representation. Expression genes are harmonized across the reference PCA, query and candidate cell-line datasets before projection.

Usage

run_tumor2line_with_reference(
  query_expr,
  reference,
  query_phenotype,
  cellline_expr = NULL,
  cellline_phenotype = NULL,
  query_sample_id_col = "SampleID",
  cellline_sample_id_col = "SampleID",
  query_lineage_col = "lineage",
  cellline_lineage_col = "lineage",
  pair_col = NULL,
  query_type = "tumor",
  cellline_type = "cellline",
  query_input_scale = c("raw", "processed"),
  cellline_input_scale = c("raw", "processed"),
  candidate_scope = c("within_lineage", "global"),
  distance = c("euclidean", "manhattan", "cosine"),
  epsilon = 0.1,
  rho_query = 1,
  rho_cellline = 1,
  max_iter = 5000,
  tolerance = 1e-08,
  evaluate = TRUE
)

Arguments

query_expr

Query expression matrix.

reference

Frozen reference PCA object from [build_reference_pca()].

query_phenotype

Query phenotype data frame.

cellline_expr

Optional candidate cell-line expression matrix. If `NULL`, reference cell-line scores are used.

cellline_phenotype

Optional phenotype for `cellline_expr`.

query_sample_id_col

Sample-ID column in query data and phenotype.

cellline_sample_id_col

Sample-ID column in candidate data and phenotype.

query_lineage_col

Harmonized lineage column in query phenotype.

cellline_lineage_col

Lineage column in candidate phenotype.

pair_col

Optional known-pair column present in both phenotypes.

query_type

Biological label assigned to query samples.

cellline_type

Biological label assigned to candidate cell lines.

query_input_scale

Input scale of query expression: `"raw"` or `"processed"`.

cellline_input_scale

Input scale of candidate expression.

candidate_scope

`"within_lineage"` or `"global"`.

distance

Distance metric for matching.

epsilon

Entropic regularization parameter.

rho_query

Query marginal-relaxation parameter.

rho_cellline

Cell-line marginal-relaxation parameter.

max_iter

Maximum Sinkhorn iterations.

tolerance

Sinkhorn convergence tolerance.

evaluate

Whether to evaluate known pairs when supplied.

Value

A `Tumor2LineResult` object.

Details

Missing reference genes are treated as reference-mean expression values, corresponding to zero after reference gene-wise standardization. The original PCA axes and PC scaling parameters are retained.
